title: Fix typos and unclear sentences in the Session 1 notes
body:
## Problem
The Session 1 notes may contain typos or sentences that a first-year student finds confusing.

## Context
Beginners judge the whole repo by Session 1.

## Expected outcome
A clearer `sessions/session-01/README.md` and `lesson.py` comments.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`, `sessions/session-01/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] At least three improvements
- [ ] `python start.py test` still passes

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add a table of typical activation energies to the Session 1 notes
body:
## Problem
Students have no feel for whether 150 kJ/mol is large or small.

## Context
Session 1 uses Ea = 150 kJ/mol as a toy value.

## Expected outcome
A short table of 4 or 5 real reactions with literature Ea values and a source for each, and a sentence saying that the course values are toy numbers.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Each value has a cited source
- [ ] Units are kJ/mol everywhere

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add a colour-blind-safe palette to the live apps
body:
## Problem
The apps use green and red for the data window and the target; some colour-blind users cannot tell them apart.

## Context
Accessibility is part of the quality checklist (QUALITY.md, item 9).

## Expected outcome
A palette or line styles that stay distinguishable in light and dark mode.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-03/app.html`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Both markers distinguishable in grayscale
- [ ] Screenshot added to the pull request

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add Session 4: fitting a curved Arrhenius plot
body:
## Problem
The roadmap's first milestone does not exist yet; Session 3 only shows that a straight line fails on a two-channel reaction.

## Context
See `promo/roadmap.md`. Students ask how to fit data that bend.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-04/` with README (sections A to F), lesson, checkpoint, exercises and app in the same style as Sessions 1 to 3.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`, `sessions/session-03/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Checkpoint prints PASS and the roadmap checkpoint is met
- [ ] Added to the tests

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Add a bootstrap interval to Session 3
body:
## Problem
Session 3 uses the t distribution and a normal approximation; students do not see a resampling alternative.

## Context
Roadmap milestone 3. The mini-project data give a formula factor of 1.78.

## Expected outcome
A `bootstrap_predict` function with a checkpoint and a short README section comparing it with `band`.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-03/lesson.py`, `promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Pure numpy, runs in under 20 seconds
- [ ] Comparison table in the README

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Reproduce the Target: points arriving with a flaring band and a shrinking ellipse
body:
## Problem
The Target animation shows the fit being updated as data arrive; there is no public implementation.

## Context
The code behind the Target is private on purpose. The roadmap gives the path.

## Expected outcome
Your own implementation, written from the roadmap, plus an animation like the Target.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] GIF of at most 3 MB with at least 30 frames
- [ ] Short write-up of your method

## Difficulty
advanced

title: Translate the Session 1 notes into Hindi
body:
## Problem
Students who prefer Hindi cannot read Session 1 comfortably.

## Context
This project teaches first- and second-year students across India; translations widen who can join.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-01/README.hi.md` with a faithful Hindi translation of sections A to F, linked from the main README.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] All sections translated
- [ ] Equations, code blocks and file names unchanged
- [ ] Link added to the main README

## Difficulty
beginner
